_comment: nix_messages.json — the netrunner at the Afterlife. VERBATIM from storyboard.lua's p2_nix beat
(`sms.thread = "nix"`). THE STORYBOARD WINS; tools/audit_messages.py enforces it.
Nix is a real character with no VO in this mod, so text is his ONLY channel — which is why his
half of Part 2 is written as SMS rather than as a dialogue node. Story-only, like the unknown
number: no ambient schedule, fired by name from arc.lua.
A PRIVATE contact rather than a merge into vanilla `nix`. Jackie is merged because his vanilla
contact and portrait were VERIFIED out of the shipped cooked_journal.journal on this Mac; Nix's
were not, and guessing an avatarID would either render blank or point at somebody else's face.
No portrait is the honest answer, so this uses the game's own no-portrait record.
If his real contact id and avatarID are ever read out of the game the same way, switching is
one line here and everything downstream regenerates.
contact.name: Nix

_comment: ⚠️ `cost` is carried through to messages_index.lua for arc.lua to charge. This module never
touches the player's eddies itself — it only reports which reply was tapped.
bubbles: A mil-spec tracker doesn't talk to Arasaka Tower. It talks to whatever mast it can see, and the mast talks to the tower. That's the seam.
I can build you something that sits in that seam. Two grand, and I don't want to know whose shoulder it's in.

replies.text: Two grand's steep for a box.

pay: Pickup's at the Afterlife. Don't bring him with you.
haggle: It's steep for a box. It's cheap for a man.
